decisions.reason: The consumer superfood drink sits far from the firm's engineering core and appears only as a mention, but it costs little to keep as a reseller product, and with the firm hiring there is enough slack to carry it for another year rather than start problemistic search.

The modular plant extensions build directly on the established waste-to-energy offer, so they support existing customers and fit the firm's direction, leaving no shortfall that would justify dropping them.

As a flagship with its own web page that builds on the core business, the waste-oil plant is central to the firm's aspirations, and in a growing industry its uncertain early results do not yet signal a shortfall.

The plastic-to-fuel plant is a strategic flagship aligned with the firm's mission, and its sparse web presence reflects an early stage rather than failure, so the firm would carry it with its R&D slack.
